HP Victus 15-fa2392tx Gaming Laptop - Intel Core i7-13620H RTX 4050 6GB


Experience top-tier competitive gaming and heavy-duty productivity with the high-performance HP Victus 15-fa2392tx gaming laptop. Powered by the formidable 13th Generation Intel Core i7-13620H processor featuring 10 cores and 16 threads, this laptop effortlessly crushes demanding modern games, video editing software, and intensive multitasking workloads. Combined with 16GB of high-speed DDR4 RAM and a lightning-fast 512GB NVMe PCIe SSD, you can expect instant system boot times, rapid game loading, and ultra-smooth performance.


The graphical powerhouse of this machine is the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 6GB GDDR6 dedicated graphics card, utilizing the advanced Ada Lovelace architecture to deliver groundbreaking features like DLSS 3 and real-time ray tracing. Enjoy your favorite AAA titles on the stunning 15.6-inch Full HD (1920x1080) display, featuring a fluid 144Hz refresh rate that eliminates screen tearing and motion blur for a true esports advantage. Equipped with an advanced thermal cooling setup, an backlit gaming keyboard, and a sleek design, the HP Victus 15 is your ultimate gateway to next-gen portable gaming.
